### Bible Pathway - Apr. 19, 2010
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-apr-19-2010-11629050.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 21:1
Points:
- David recognized Israel's prolonged famine as divine chastisement and sought the Lord's counsel.
- The calamity was traced to Saul's violation of Israel's ancient covenant with the Gibeonites.
- Divine justice required moral restitution for murder rather than financial settlement.
- David preserved Mephibosheth to remain faithful to his prior oath to Jonathan.
- God holds His people accountable to keep solemn vows regardless of shifting circumstances.
